instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the messages from the Slack channels my bot is in into my own records", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-slack-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Reads the public channels the bot is a member of, only the messages newer than the last pull (the cursor is the newest message time seen, and moves only when no request failed), and keeps them in your records: a message pulled twice is kept once and an edited message replaces the older copy.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list, records:write).
